FAQ.

All common questions about our templates

Do I need to know how to code to use these templates?

Nope! All Velox templates are built 100% in Framer, so you can customize everything visually. No code needed

How do I access my purchase?

You can find your templates after purchase by accessing our Polar customer portal

Can I get a refund after purchase?

Since these are digital products with instant access after purchase, there’s no way for us to remove the link once it’s been shared, which means we can’t offer refunds. That said, if you run into any issues, just reach out, we’re here to help and will do our best to support you.

Can I use one template for multiple clients?

Yes! Make sure to choose the right license to use the template on unlimited client projects.

Will I get updates if the template changes?

Yes. If we update the template or add improvements, you’ll get access to the latest version by re-remixing the template

Do you offer support after purchase?

Yes! We’re happy to help you set up your template, fix bugs, or guide you through features that come with the original design. Our goal is to make sure your website looks just like the demo and runs smoothly on Framer.

Can I get help with custom changes or new components?

If it’s not part of the original template, like adding new sections, custom code, or unique layouts, it’s outside our standard support. We focus on helping you use the template as provided so everyone gets quick and reliable help. If you need custom work, we can connect you with a trusted Framer expert.

Can we book a call or screen share session?

We currently don’t offer live calls or 1-on-1 sessions. Our support is 100% async, meaning we’ll guide you through email, docs, or videos. This helps us respond faster and keep support fair for everyone.

I’ve customized the template a lot and something broke. Can you fix it?

Once you make major changes, it’s hard for us to debug since it’s no longer the same setup. We’ll try to point you in the right direction, but we can’t guarantee a fix for heavily modified templates. If you need advanced troubleshooting, we recommend hiring a developer familiar with Framer.

Can I pay extra for a custom version or setup help?

We don’t offer paid customization or setup services at the moment. Our focus is on building great templates and providing clear support for what’s included. If you need something custom, we recommend hiring a Framer expert who can tailor it to your needs.

Who we are.

We started Velox Themes to solve a daily problem:


Clients not knowing what they want. We wasted too much time guessing.


Templates solved that. They helped us move faster, close more projects, and stop overthinking design.


But most website templates were too generic. So we made our own.

Gil designs. Bayu market. Together, we build fast, beautiful, and client-ready Webflow & Framer templates to help people build great websites.


And we give back. Every sale helps someone beyond the design world.


Velox Themes is just the beginning.


We’re building a digital product brand for creators like you.
